Bookmark this Posting Print Preview | Apply for this Job Posting Information Posting Information Position Title Adjunct Instructor - Construction Technology Job Duties Butler Community College is seeking a part-time instructor to teach Construction Technology courses at the El Dorado Correctional Facility. Construction Technology courses will be focused in one or more construction subject areas: OSHA10, Craft Fundamentals, Intro. to Craft Skills, Intro. to Carpentry, Floors and Stairs, Ceiling, Walls and Building Systems, Roofing and Exteriors, Cabinet Making and Installation, Intro. to Electrical, Intro. to Masonry, Intro. to HVAC & Plumbing, and/or Construction Management.Butler Community College can arrange a tour of the correctional facility for interested applicants. Applicants can email acornett@butlercc.edu to arrange a tour. Campus Locations EDCF Nature of Position Adjunct Instructor If Part Time, list Working Hours Salary (Commensurate with education and experience) $850 per credit hour taught. We regret that the College is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status. Qualifications Required knowledge and skills Positive attitude and strong work ethic Desire to help students succeed in and outside the classroom Desire to learn Ability to lift and move supplies and equipment weighing up to 100 lbs. Work effectively and productively as a team member. Keep others informed of information needed. Treat others with respect, maintaining a spirit of cooperation. Maintain effective and professional verbal and written interactions with peers, students, supervisors, and other staff. Use diplomacy and tact in dealing with difficult situations or people. Demonstrate effective listening skills. Is receptive to constructive feedback. Ensures appropriate notification to supervisor for absences, and ensures that work is covered. Completes assigned work; meets deadlines without reminders/follow-up from supervisor or others. Perform work conscientiously with a high degree of accuracy. Ability to work independently with little or no supervision. Ability to use a computer and software applications. Ability to meet deadlines. Required experience Strong knowledge of construction industry standards and processes Strong knowledge of tools and equipment used within the construction industry Required educational background Associate degree in construction technology, carpentry or related field; 5 years (10,000 hours) minimum experience without an associate degree. Bookmark this Posting Print Preview | Apply for this Job Posting Information Posting Information Position Title Adult Basic Education Instructor- Outreach Job Duties Responsible for instruction of literacy, adult basic education, college readiness and GED preparation instruction at outreach locations, such as the Butler Service Center, Wichita locations, and the Butler Andover campus. In addition to basic skills instruction, other content such as basic technology, work readiness, and Accuplacer preparation will be taught as needed. Act as the liaison between the outreach location, additional outreach location staff and Butler of El Dorado Center to effectively and efficiently provide Adult Education services. Instructor will be held accountable for students acquiring the state average in educational gains plus the four primary goals set by the National Reporting System. Will work as a team with the director, data entry person and other instructional staff to develop curriculum, administer appropriate assessment(s), conduct follow-up, and to maintain and update records required for effective and efficient delivery of program services. Instructor may be asked to occasionally substitute for other instructors. Perform routine office procedures as needed. Program standards require the employee to actively participate in professional development activities for Kansas Board of Regents trainings. Outreach locations include Wichita and surrounding areas. This position is for evening and weekends, with a potential for some day time hours. This is a grant funded position.Andover 4-8 pm Tuesday and ThursdayWichita 1230-330 pm Tuesday and Friday Campus Locations Multiple Sites Nature of Position Part Time; # hours per week - 10-15 hours/week If Part Time, list Working Hours Must be available for evening classes and weekends Hourly rate of pay Starting at $19.00 with credit for education and experience. Open Date 06/10/2026 Close Date Open Until Filled Special Instructions Summary Qualifications The applicant may be requested to authorize the College to procure a consumer report(s) for employment purposes. We regret that the College is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status. Qualifications Required knowledge and skills Thorough knowledge of subject matter; thorough knowledge of competency-based instruction; basic computer skills; human relations skills; flexibility in modifying workload and schedule to meet peek demands; competency in teaching developmental, Pre-GED, GED, technology, pre-employment, and advanced transitional skills; ability to create individual study plans based on special needs of students or individual differences and individual goals. Required experience Previous teaching experience with adults ages 16 and over; experience with competency-based instructional methods; developmental education experience preferred. Required educational background B.S. or B.A. degree in Secondary Education, Elementary Education, Special Education or related field is required.
